stages.query: SELECT "__path","fn","member","mode" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT a.__path,a.fn,rx_replace(a.member,'\s+','') member,a.mode FROM cache_attributes a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mutations x WHERE x.__path=a.__path AND x.id=a.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM member_aliases x WHERE x.__path=a.__path AND x.id=a.id) AND a.member NOT IN ('__class__','__delattr__','__dict__','__getattribute__','__setattr__'))

stages.query:
SELECT "__path","assignment","node" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE walk(__path,assignment,node) AS (
        SELECT a.__path,a.id,a.value FROM assignments a JOIN nodes stmt ON stmt.__path=a.__path AND stmt.id=a.parent JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=stmt.__path AND parent.id=stmt.parent WHERE parent.kind='module'
        UNION ALL SELECT w.__path,w.assignment,child.id FROM walk w JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=w.__path AND n.id=w.node JOIN nodes child ON child.__path=n.__path AND (n.kind IN ('tuple','parenthesized_expression') AND child.parent=n.id OR n.kind='call' AND child.parent=n.arguments_id) WHERE child.kind!='comment') SELECT * FROM walk)

stages.query:

        WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM global_value_walk w JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=w.__path AND n.id=w.node WHERE w.__path=a.__path AND w.assignment=a.id AND NOT (

        )))

stages.query: SELECT "__path","fn","error" FROM (SELECT arg.__path,arg.fn,'cache argument '||quote(arg.name)||' cannot have a default' error FROM cache_arguments arg JOIN parameters p ON p.__path=arg.__path AND p.fn=arg.fn AND p.name=arg.name WHERE p.kind IN ('default_parameter','typed_default_parameter') UNION ALL SELECT arg.__path,arg.fn,'cache argument '||quote(arg.name)||' must be f ON f.__path=p.__path AND f.id=p.fn WHERE arg.name!='self' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes star WHERE star.__path=f.__path AND star.parent=f.parameters_id AND star.__start<param.__start AND stages.name: annotation_reprs
stages.query:
SELECT "record_id","ordinal","repr" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE chars(record_id,ordinal,value,delimiter,position,piece) AS (
      SELECT record_id,ordinal,annotation,CASE WHEN instr(annotation,'''')>0 AND instr(annotation,'"')=0 THEN '"' ELSE '''' END,0,'' FROM actual_annotations
      UNION ALL SELECT record_id,ordinal,value,delimiter,position+1,
        CASE WHEN substr(value,position+1,1)='\' THEN '\\'
          WHEN substr(value,position+1,1)=delimiter THEN '\'||delimiter
          WHEN unicode(substr(value,position+1,1))=9 THEN '\t'
          WHEN unicode(substr(value,position+1,1))=10 THEN '\n'
          WHEN unicode(substr(value,position+1,1))=13 THEN '\r'
          WHEN substr(value,position+1,1)!=' ' AND rx_matches(substr(value,position+1,1),'^[\p{C}\p{Z}]$') THEN
            CASE WHEN unicode(substr(value,position+1,1))<256 THEN printf('\x%02x',unicode(substr(value,position+1,1)))
                 WHEN unicode(substr(value,position+1,1))<65536 THEN printf('\u%04x',unicode(substr(value,position+1,1)))
                 ELSE printf('\U%08x',unicode(substr(value,position+1,1))) END
          ELSE substr(value,position+1,1) END
      FROM chars WHERE position<length(value))
      SELECT record_id,ordinal,delimiter||group_concat(piece,'')||delimiter repr FROM
        (SELECT * FROM chars ORDER BY record_id,ordinal,position) GROUP BY record_id,ordinal,delimiter)

stages.name: decorator_names
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","fn","decorator","node","name" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE walk(__path,fn,decorator,node) AS (
        SELECT f.__path,f.id,d.id,x.id FROM declarations f JOIN nodes wrapper ON wrapper.__path=f.__path AND wrapper.id=f.parent AND wrapper.kind='decorated_definition' JOIN nodes d ON d.__path=wrapper.__path AND d.parent=wrapper.id AND d.kind='decorator' JOIN nodes x ON x.__path=d.__path AND x.parent=d.id
        UNION ALL SELECT w.__path,w.fn,w.decorator,c.callee_id FROM walk w JOIN calls c ON c.__path=w.__path AND c.id=w.node)
        SELECT w.__path,w.fn,w.decorator,w.node,coalesce(a.attr,n.text) name FROM walk w JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=w.__path AND n.id=w.node LEFT JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=n.__path AND a.id=n.id WHERE n.kind IN ('identifier','attribute'))

stages.query: SELECT "__path","id","function","body_sha256","signature_sha256" FROM (SELECT f.__path,f.id,f.function,h.body_sha256,h.signature_sha256 FROM selected_functions f JOIN fingerprints h ON h.__path=f.__path AND h.id=f.id)

stages.name: memoized_bounds
stages.query: SELECT "__path","id",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "text","value","max_entries" FROM (SELECT f.__path,f.id,k.kind,k.text,k.value,CASE WHEN k.kind='integer' THEN CAST(replace(k.text,'_','') AS INTEGER) END max_entries FROM selected_functions f LEFT JOIN keywords k ON k.__path=f.__path AND k.call=f.decorator AND k.name='max_entries')

stages.name: memoized_errors
stages.query: SELECT "__path","fn",NULL AS "function","error" FROM (SELECT f.__path,f.id fn,f.function,'memoized_pure_lazy requires the canonical pure_lazy marker' error FROM selected_functions f WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decorator_names d JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=d.__path AND n.id=d.node JOIN nodes par ON par.__path=n.__path AND par.id=n.parent WHERE d.__path=f.__path AND d.fn=f.id AND d.name='pure_lazy' AND n.kind='identifier' AND par.kind='decorator') UNION ALL SELECT f.__path,f.id fn,f.function,'memoized_pure_lazy requires one literal max_entries keyword' FROM selected_functions f WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM keywords k WHERE k.__path=f.__path AND k.call=f.decorator)!=1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM keywords k WHERE k.__path=f.__path AND k.call=f.decorator AND k.name='max_entries') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arguments a WHERE a.__path=f.__path AND a.call=f.decorator) UNION ALL SELECT f.__path,f.id fn,f.function,'memoized_pure_lazy max_entries must be a literal integer' FROM selected_functions f JOIN memoized_bounds b ON b.__path=f.__path AND b.id=f.id WHERE b.max_entries IS NULL AND b.value IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT f.__path,f.id fn,f.function,'memoized_pure_lazy max_entries must be positive' FROM selected_functions f JOIN memoized_bounds b ON b.__path=f.__path AND b.id=f.id WHERE b.max_entries<1 UNION ALL SELECT __path,id fn,function,'memoized pure-lazy functions must be synchronous' FROM selected_functions WHERE rx_matches(text,'^async\s') UNION ALL SELECT f.__path,f.id fn,f.function,'memoized pure-lazy functions cannot use variadic arguments' FROM selected_functions f WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes n WHERE n.__path=f.__path AND n.__start>=f.parameters_start AND n.__end<=f.parameters_end AND n.kind IN ('list_splat_pattern','dictionary_splat_pattern')) UNION ALL SELECT f.__path,f.id fn,f.function,'memoized pure-lazy functions cannot be generators' FROM selected_functions f WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes n WHERE n.__path=f.__path AND n.__start>=f.body_start AND n.__end<=f.body_end AND n.kind='yield'))

stages.name: coordinate_roots
stages.query: SELECT "__path","id" FROM (SELECT __path,id FROM nodes WHERE kind='identifier' AND text IN ('memoized_pure_lazy','_MEMOIZED_PURE_LAZY_STATE_CREATION_LOCK','_MemoizedPureLazyState','_memoized_purity_decorator') AND __path NOT LIKE '%l2055_lazy_result/purity.py')

stages.name: memoized_aliases
stages.query: SELECT "__path","id","function","error" FROM (SELECT n.__path,n.id,m.module||'.<memoized_decorator_alias_'||(n.line+1)||'>' function,'memoized_pure_lazy decorator aliases are forbidden' error FROM nodes n JOIN module_names m ON m.__path=n.__path JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=n.__path AND parent.id=n.parent AND parent.kind='module' JOIN nodes a ON a.__path=n.__path AND a.parent=n.id WHERE n.kind='import_from_statement' AND n.module_name_source='l2055_lazy_result.purity' AND a.kind='aliased_import' AND a.name_source='memoized_pure_lazy' UNION ALL SELECT n.__path,n.id,m.module||'.<private_memoized_storage_access_'||(n.line+1)||'_'||(SELECT column FROM coordinates h WHERE h.__path=n.__path AND h.id=n.id)||'>','direct access to private memoization storage is forbidden' FROM nodes n JOIN module_names m ON m.__path=n.__path LEFT JOIN nodes par ON par.__path=n.__path AND par.id=n.parent WHERE n.kind='identifier' AND n.text IN ('_MEMOIZED_PURE_LAZY_STATE_CREATION_LOCK','_MemoizedPureLazyState','_memoized_purity_decorator') AND par.kind NOT IN ('dotted_name','aliased_import','import_from_statement') AND n.__path NOT LIKE '%l2055_lazy_result/purity.py' UNION ALL SELECT n.__path,n.id,m.module||'.<escaped_memoized_decorator_'||(n.line+1)||'_'||(SELECT column FROM coordinates h WHERE h.__path=n.__path AND h.id=n.id)||'>','memoized_pure_lazy cannot escape as a first-class value' FROM nodes n JOIN module_names m ON m.__path=n.__path JOIN nodes par ON par.__path=n.__path AND par.id=n.parent WHERE n.kind='identifier' AND n.text='memoized_pure_lazy' AND par.kind NOT IN ('dotted_name','aliased_import','import_from_statement') AND n.__path NOT LIKE '%l2055_lazy_result/purity.py' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM selected_functions f WHERE f.__path=n.__path AND f.decorator=par.id AND par.function_id=n.id))

stages.name: actual_records
stages.query: SELECT "record_id","function","body_hash","signature_hash","max_entries","ordinal" FROM (SELECT r.*,row_number() OVER(ORDER BY function)-1 ordinal FROM (SELECT f.__path||':'||f.id record_id,f.function,f.body_sha256 body_hash,f.signature_sha256 signature_hash,b.max_entries FROM actual_functions f JOIN memoized_bounds b ON b.__path=f.__path AND b.id=f.id UNION ALL SELECT a.__path||':'||a.id,a.function,h.dump_sha256,h.dump_sha256,NULL FROM memoized_aliases a JOIN alias_fingerprints h ON h.__path=a.__path AND h.id=a.id) r)

stages.name: actual_errors
stages.query: SELECT "record_id","ordinal","error" FROM (SELECT record_id,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY record_id ORDER BY error)-1 ordinal,error FROM (SELECT f.__path||':'||f.id record_id,e.error FROM actual_functions f JOIN memoized_errors e ON e.__path=f.__path AND e.fn=f.id UNION SELECT a.__path||':'||a.id,a.error FROM memoized_aliases a))

stages.name: effective_actual
stages.query: SELECT NULL AS "record_id","function","body_hash","signature_hash","max_entries",NULL AS "ordinal" FROM (SELECT * FROM actual_records a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM actual_records later WHERE later.function=a.function AND later.ordinal>a.ordinal))

stages.name: ordered_policy_issues
stages.query: SELECT "phase","step","ordinal","function","issue" FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT 0 phase,0 step,0 ordinal,x.* FROM (SELECT function,'duplicate memoized decorator entry: '||function issue FROM actual_records GROUP BY function HAVING count(*)>1) x) UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT 0 phase,1 step,0 ordinal,x.* FROM (SELECT function,'duplicate memoized policy entry: '||function issue FROM policy_records GROUP BY function HAVING count(*)>1) x) UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT 1 phase,0 step,printf('%020d/%020d',a.ordinal,e.ordinal) ordinal,a.function,a.function||': '||e.error issue FROM actual_errors e JOIN actual_records a ON a.record_id=e.record_id ORDER BY a.ordinal,e.ordinal) UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT 2 phase,0 step,0 ordinal,x.* FROM (SELECT a.function,'unsigned memoized pure-lazy function: '||a.function issue FROM effective_actual a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM policy_entries p WHERE p.function=a.function)) x) UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT 3 phase,0 step,0 ordinal,x.* FROM (SELECT p.function,'stale memoized pure-lazy policy entry: '||p.function issue FROM policy_entries p WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM effective_actual a WHERE a.function=p.function)) x) UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT 4 phase,0 step,0 ordinal,x.* FROM (SELECT a.function,a.function||': '||('memoization bound changed') issue FROM effective_actual a JOIN policy_entries p ON p.function=a.function  WHERE a.max_entries IS NOT json_extract(p.data,'$.max_entries')) x) UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT 4 phase,1 step,0 ordinal,x.* FROM (SELECT a.function,a.function||': '||('cache lifetime is not approved') issue FROM effective_actual a JOIN policy_entries p ON p.function=a.function  WHERE json_extract(p.data,'$.cache_lifetime') IS NOT 'process') x) UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT 4 phase,2 step,0 ordinal,x.* FROM (SELECT a.function,a.function||': '||('key policy is not approved') issue FROM effective_actual a JOIN policy_entries p ON p.function=a.function  WHERE json_extract(p.data,'$.key_policy') IS NOT 'bound_explicit_immutable_v1') x) UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT 4 phase,3 step,0 ordinal,x.* FROM (SELECT a.function,a.function||': '||('return policy is not approved') issue FROM effective_actual a JOIN policy_entries p ON p.function=a.function  WHERE json_extract(p.data,'$.return_policy') IS NOT 'immutable_no_alias_v1') x) UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT 4 phase,4 step,0 ordinal,x.* FROM (SELECT a.function,a.function||': '||('exception policy is not approved') issue FROM effective_actual a JOIN policy_entries p ON p.function=a.function  WHERE json_extract(p.data,'$.exception_policy') IS NOT 'successful_results_only_v1') x) UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT 4 phase,5 step,0 ordinal,x.* FROM (SELECT a.function,a.function||': '||('review rationale is required') issue FROM effective_actual a JOIN policy_entries p ON p.function=a.function  WHERE trim(p.rationale)='') x) UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT 4 phase,7 step,0 ordinal,x.* FROM (SELECT a.function,a.function||': '||('function body hash changed') issue FROM effective_actual a JOIN policy_entries p ON p.function=a.function  WHERE a.body_hash!=p.body_hash) x) UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT 4 phase,8 step,0 ordinal,x.* FROM (SELECT a.function,a.function||': '||('function signature hash changed') issue FROM effective_actual a JOIN policy_entries p ON p.function=a.function  WHERE a.signature_hash!=p.signature_hash) x))

stages.name: diagnostics
stages.query: SELECT "issue" FROM (SELECT issue FROM ordered_policy_issues ORDER BY phase,CASE WHEN phase=1 AND 1 THEN '' ELSE function END,step,ordinal)

stages.name: calls
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end","id",NULL AS "parent",NULL AS "edge_parent",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_start",NULL AS "name_end",NULL AS "name_kind",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_id",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "left_source",NULL AS "right_id",NULL AS "right_start",NULL AS "right_end",NULL AS "right_kind",NULL AS "value_id",NULL AS "value_start",NULL AS "value_end",NULL AS "value_kind",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind","arguments_id",NULL AS "arguments_start",NULL AS "arguments_end",NULL AS "arguments_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_source",NULL AS "callee_id",NULL AS "callee_kind",NULL AS "full_callee","callee",NULL AS "receiver" FROM (SELECT n.*,f.id AS callee_id,f.kind AS callee_kind,f.text AS full_callee,coalesce(a.attr,f.text) AS callee,a.object AS receiver FROM nodes n JOIN nodes f ON f.__path=n.__path AND f.id=n.function_id LEFT JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=f.__path AND a.id=f.id WHERE n.kind='call')

stages.name: keywords
stages.query: SELECT "__path","call",NULL AS "keyword",NULL AS "keyword_start","name","value",NULL AS "__start",NULL AS "__end",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "kind" FROM (SELECT c.__path,c.id AS call,k.id AS keyword,k.__start AS keyword_start,kn.text AS name,v.id AS value,v.__start,v.__end,v.text,v.kind FROM calls c JOIN nodes k ON k.__path=c.__path AND k.parent=c.arguments_id AND k.kind='keyword_argument' JOIN nodes kn ON kn.__path=k.__path AND kn.id=k.name_id JOIN nodes v ON v.__path=k.__path AND v.id=k.value_id)

stages.name: assignments
stages.query: SELECT "__path",NULL AS "__start",NULL AS "__end","id",NULL AS "parent",NULL AS "edge_parent",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_start",NULL AS "name_end",NULL AS "name_kind",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "left_id",NULL AS "left_start",NULL AS "left_end",NULL AS "left_kind",NULL AS "left_source",NULL AS "right_id","right_start","right_end",NULL AS "right_kind",NULL AS "value_id",NULL AS "value_start",NULL AS "value_end",NULL AS "value_kind",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "arguments_id",NULL AS "arguments_start",NULL AS "arguments_end",NULL AS "arguments_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_source",NULL AS "target",NULL AS "target_kind","target_text","value",NULL AS "expr_kind",NULL AS "expr_text","fn" FROM (SELECT n.*,l.id AS target,l.kind AS target_kind,l.text AS target_text,r.id AS value,r.kind AS expr_kind,r.text AS expr_text,o.fn FROM nodes n JOIN nodes l ON l.__path=n.__path AND l.id=n.left_id LEFT JOIN nodes r ON r.__path=n.__path AND r.id=n.right_id LEFT JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=n.__path AND o.id=n.id WHERE n.kind='assignment')

stages.name: runtime_nodes
stages.query: SELECT "label","name","__path","id" FROM (SELECT p.label,p.name,n.__path,n.id FROM protected_names p JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=p.path LEFT JOIN nodes wrapper ON wrapper.__path=n.__path AND wrapper.id=n.parent AND wrapper.kind='decorated_definition' JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=n.__path AND parent.id=coalesce(wrapper.parent,n.parent) WHERE (n.kind IN ('function_definition','class_definition') AND n.name_source=p.name AND parent.kind='module') OR (n.kind='assignment' AND n.left_source=p.name AND parent.kind='expression_statement' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes m WHERE m.__path=parent.__path AND m.id=parent.parent AND m.kind='module')))

stages.name: runtime_hash
stages.query: SELECT "actual" FROM (SELECT sha256(group_concat(value,'|')) actual FROM (SELECT r.label||':'||r.name||':'||d.dump value FROM runtime_nodes r JOIN runtime_dumps d ON d.__path=r.__path AND d.id=r.id ORDER BY r.name))

stages.name: entry_keywords
stages.query: SELECT "__path","id","name","entry" FROM (SELECT k.__path,k.value id,k.name,c.id entry FROM calls c JOIN keywords k ON k.__path=c.__path AND k.call=c.id JOIN assignments a ON a.__path=c.__path AND c.__start>=a.right_start AND c.__end<=a.right_end WHERE c.__path='l2055_lazy_result/cached_pure_lazy_policy.py' AND c.callee IN ('CachedPureLazyPolicyEntry','MemoizedPureLazyPolicyEntry') AND a.target_text IN ('_POLICY_ENTRIES','_MEMOIZED_POLICY_ENTRIES'))

stages.name: metadata_assignments
stages.query: SELECT "__path","id","name" FROM (SELECT a.__path,a.value id,a.target_text name FROM assignments a WHERE a.__path='l2055_lazy_result/cached_pure_lazy_policy.py' AND a.target_text IN ('ALLOWLIST_SIGNATURE','ALLOWLIST_NAME','ALLOWLIST_VERSION','CACHED_PURE_LAZY_RUNTIME_SOURCE_HASH','CACHED_PURE_LAZY_RUNTIME_SYMBOL_NAMES'))

stages.name: literal_roots
stages.query: SELECT "__path","id" FROM (SELECT __path,id FROM entry_keywords UNION SELECT __path,id FROM metadata_assignments)

stages.name: metadata
stages.query: SELECT "name","value","literal_json" FROM (SELECT m.name,json_extract(v.literal_json,'$') value,v.literal_json FROM metadata_assignments m JOIN literal_values v ON v.__path=m.__path AND v.id=m.id)

stages.name: canonical_entries
stages.query: SELECT NULL AS "entry","value" FROM (SELECT entry,json_group_object(name,json(literal_json)) value FROM (SELECT k.entry,k.name,v.literal_json FROM entry_keywords k JOIN literal_values v ON v.__path=k.__path AND v.id=k.id ORDER BY k.entry,k.name) GROUP BY entry)

stages.name: runtime_metadata
stages.query: SELECT "value" FROM (SELECT json_object('runtime_source_hash',(SELECT value FROM metadata WHERE name='CACHED_PURE_LAZY_RUNTIME_SOURCE_HASH'),'runtime_symbols',json((SELECT literal_json FROM metadata WHERE name='CACHED_PURE_LAZY_RUNTIME_SYMBOL_NAMES'))) value)

stages.name: signed_payload
stages.query: SELECT "message" FROM (SELECT json_object('allowlist',json_group_array(value),'linter',(SELECT value FROM metadata WHERE name='ALLOWLIST_NAME'),'version',(SELECT value FROM metadata WHERE name='ALLOWLIST_VERSION')) message FROM (SELECT value FROM (SELECT value FROM canonical_entries UNION ALL SELECT value FROM runtime_metadata) ORDER BY value))

stages.name: signature_valid
stages.query: SELECT "valid" FROM (SELECT verify_ed25519('7e9776d87292ab633115bd6c07892a4bf56450fffb2dfcf13b3eba1866b9fbb6',p.message,(SELECT value FROM metadata WHERE name='ALLOWLIST_SIGNATURE')) valid FROM signed_payload p)

stages.name: diagnostics
stages.query: SELECT "issue" FROM (SELECT 'cached pure-lazy runtime symbol metadata changed' issue WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM json_each((SELECT literal_json FROM metadata WHERE name='CACHED_PURE_LAZY_RUNTIME_SYMBOL_NAMES')))!=(SELECT count(*) FROM protected_names) OR EXISTS(SELECT name FROM protected_names EXCEPT SELECT value FROM json_each((SELECT literal_json FROM metadata WHERE name='CACHED_PURE_LAZY_RUNTIME_SYMBOL_NAMES'))) UNION ALL SELECT 'cached pure-lazy runtime source hash changed: actual='||h.actual||' policy='||m.value FROM runtime_hash h JOIN metadata m ON m.name='CACHED_PURE_LAZY_RUNTIME_SOURCE_HASH' WHERE h.actual!=m.value UNION ALL SELECT 'cached pure-lazy policy signature is invalid' FROM signature_valid WHERE NOT valid)

cases.all: SELECT 'l2055_lazy_result/cached_pure_lazy_policy.py' path,0 start_byte,0 end_byte,issue,issue identity FROM diagnostics

query.default: SELECT 'l2055_lazy_result/cached_pure_lazy_policy.py' path,0 start_byte,0 end_byte,issue,issue identity FROM diagnostics WHERE 0
